title: Townsfolk
summary: Foxwillow's townsfolk chart (R13): who is what to whom, filled in as the secrets come out.
empty: Nobody here talks about anybody else. Not yet.

entries.title: Martha
entries.text: Runs the inn. Mother of Adelaide and Isaac.

entries.title: William and Isaac
entries.text: Father and son, though Isaac never knew it.

entries.title: William and Jonah
entries.text: William sells Jonah his livestock; Jonah hexed William's fields.

entries.title: Isaac and Jonah
entries.text: Isaac learned his trade under Jonah.

entries.title: Adelaide and Isaac
entries.text: Sister and brother. She killed him.
